correctness.rationale: The exact coefficient Gram formula, uniform binomial maximal mass bound, Laplace diagonal expansion, exponential collision-moment off-diagonal bound, and trace-class sum were reconstructed. The sharp beta exponent comes from normalized unit-vector images; sufficiency splits off a regular Hardy-input complement. At the critical exponent the positive Gram operator differs in trace norm from c_t I, giving the essential spectral scalar, while geometric rank truncation yields all Schatten p below threshold. The 1,183 finite checks independently corroborate algebraic identities but do not prove infinite assertions.

value.rationale: The exact half-power phase transition isolates a genuine boundary between bounded and unbounded affine composition operators on a natural dyadically punctured Hardy family. The exceptional input channel changes from rapidly Schatten-regular to a scaled isometry modulo trace class at the same boundary; its essential singular value varies explicitly with the contact slope. This is a quantitative spectral refinement not implied by qualitative equality of Hilbert-Schmidt symbol classes.
